title: Protecting SRHR Amid Global Funding Cuts and Gag Rule
discussion_signal: PMNCH’s discussion links funding cuts and geopolitical instability to program downsizing, closures, service disruption, and fragmentation of civil-society coalitions affecting sexual, reproductive, women’s, children’s, and adolescents’ health.
linked_research_question: How does global health-financing pressure move from organizational budgets into program closures, service contraction, and unequal rights exposure?
limits: The post reports partner-reported impacts rather than independently verified service statistics
Advocacy framing emphasizes harms and may not capture funder constraints
It does not estimate long-run health outcomes
